title: The conormal identity for a pair of ideals generated by an H1-regular sequence
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the intersection of an ideal with the square of a larger ideal under the hypothesis that the quotient of the two ideals is generated by an H1-regular sequence, and the proof is an 18-line argument in two steps. It chooses generators of the larger ideal modulo the smaller one, writes an element of the intersection in a three-part decomposition accordingly, observes that the middle part lies in the smaller ideal intersected with the ideal generated by the sequence, and then applies the intersection lemma of the same section to move that part into the product of the two ideals. The decomposition of the element and the application of the earlier intersection statement are the two ingredients, and both are displayed.
